function: Gesture recognition (8 classes) from 5G mmWave power-per-beam-pair measurements with a semi-supervised GAN; a sensing task, not beam, waveform or resource design (p. 7: "our focus is on the sensing aspect of ISAC").
notes: Excluded for function (Step 1, code 5). The learned model is the discriminator CNN of mmGAN, which classifies one of eight gestures from power per beam pair (p. 2: "classification into one of eight gestures"; p. 7: "In this work, our focus is on the sensing aspect of ISAC"). It does not learn beams, waveforms, or resources that serve sensing and communication, so it solves the problem of none of the seven areas; the sensing-communication trade-off is left to future work (p. 21: "our dataset could be used to analyze the trade-off"). Borderline for the reviewer: the system does communicate (5G NR frame with SSB and random data, p. 7), but communication is only the source of the signal; the task is a sensing application like localization or activity recognition.
